title: A modified sol-gel synthesis protocol for high-quality ZnSnO₃ thin films with enhanced electrical and optical properties for energy and sensor applications
author: Rajesh, Rajalingam

steps.title: Dissolve zinc acetate
steps.instruction: Weigh 2.195 g (10 mmol) of zinc acetate dihydrate and dissolve it in 40 mL of ethanol while stirring magnetically.

steps.title: Prepare tin precursor
steps.instruction: Dilute 2.37 mL of SnCl₄ (10 mmol) in 5 mL of distilled water and stir to obtain a clear tin precursor solution.

steps.title: Add stabilizing agent
steps.instruction: Add 0.6 mL of monoethanolamine (MEA, 10 mmol) to the combined zinc and tin solutions to achieve a 1:1 molar ratio with the total metal ions.

steps.title: Adjust concentration and pH
steps.instruction: Ensure the final mixed precursor solution contains 0.25 M metal ions per component; verify that the solution pH is 7.3.

steps.title: Heat and stir
steps.instruction: Heat the solution to 60 °C and stir continuously for 2 hours.

steps.title: Age the solution
steps.instruction: Allow the stirred solution to stand at room temperature for 24 hours to promote homogeneity and complexation.

steps.title: Filter precursor
steps.instruction: Before deposition, filter the aged precursor through a 0.45 µm PTFE membrane to remove any clumps.

steps.title: Use within freshness window
steps.instruction: Use the filtered precursor solution within 48 hours of preparation to ensure repeatable film quality.
